acceptance_criteria.criterion: An authenticated exact-head Codex summary with status=completed must end optional reviewer waiting even when finding-summary fields are null; it must not create review/merge authority, while unresolved threads and CHANGES_REQUESTED remain fail-closed.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Added separate completed-vs-clear parser semantics; collector uses completed only to terminalize unavailability. 646 focused tests + Defect Prevention Guard + Ruff pass.
